pulse.text: **Google's Gemini 3.5 Pro odds snapped back up** — Polymarket's mid-August leg rebounded to **54% from 45%**, the Aug 7 leg nearly doubled to 11% from 6%, and the Aug 31 leg firmed to **92% from 88%** on $459K traded, reversing the slide that led the last two sweeps. Anthropic's next Mythos-class model moved with it, its Sep 30 leg jumping to **77% from 71%**, while GPT-6 drifted a point in each direction — Aug 31 to 16%, Sep 30 to 62%, Dec 31 down to 89% on an $828K book. Nothing shipped: **Claude Opus 5 still leads the Artificial Analysis Index at 61**, ahead of Fable 5 (60), GPT-5.6 Sol (59) and Kimi K3 (57), and Anthropic's best-model books held at 96% for August and 90% for September. The press story is price rather than capability — Axios framed DeepSeek's V4-Flash-0731 as an accelerant in AI's **race to zero**, with output at roughly 28 cents against $25 for Claude Opus 4.8, days after OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna about 80%. Watch the Aug 7 Gemini leg, which expires in six days and is the first clean test of whether this firming is signal or noise.
